items.title: Cost-of-living protests spread to Germany on Halloween as France braces for fresh unrest
items.brief: Cost-of-living protests that began in France have spread to Germany where demonstrations that coincide with Halloween are underway on Saturday, with tens of thousands of people expected to turn out across the country.

items.title: Police detain 3 protesters during overnight rally as Polish president backs suspended judge
items.brief: Hundreds of anti-government protesters rallied overnight around a top court in Poland to denounce the suspension of the tribunal’s president, for which they blame the country’s pro-European government.

items.title: 1 dead, 6 wounded in shooting at California Spirit Halloween store

items.title: Zelensky welcomes sale of crucial US Patriot missiles but warns delivery could take years
